name: met-art-research
description: Search the Met collection, view artwork images, and download references with catalog information.

interface.longDescription: Search the Metropolitan Museum of Art collection using a local agent skill and Python script. Filter catalog records, view numbered contact sheets, and download previews or originals with source and rights information. Requires Python 3.10+ and a desktop agent that can run commands and view local images. Contact sheets require Pillow. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
defaultPrompt: Find botanical artworks at the Met and show me contact sheets of promising references.
Search broadly for Japanese textiles and help me narrow the results visually.
Save original images of these Met artworks to my references folder with citations.
